{{Quote|Praise circumstances for the time of your birth, young one. For you will know the honor and responsibilities and delights of being among the first in five millennia to leave Kesh&hellip;and rejoin our brethren, from whom we have been separated for so very long, to take your place in ruling a Sith galaxy.|Olaris Rhea, to Vestara Khai|<ref name="Omen" />}}
The '''emergence''' of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] marked the entrance of descendants of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] into [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] affairs after [[Standard year/Legends|millennia]] of isolation. In [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], the [[Sith dreadnaught|dreadnaught]] ''[[Omen]]'' [[Skirmish over Phaegon III|crashed]] on Kesh, and the survivors of the accident formed the Lost Tribe. They were unable to contact the outside [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] or repair their [[Starship/Legends|vessel]], so the Tribe remained trapped on the world until the arrival of a Sith Meditation Sphere known as [[Ship (Sith Meditation Sphere)|Ship]] in [[41 ABY]]. Ship helped take the Lost Tribe offworld to stage [[Skirmish near Eriadu|attacks]] on vessels, which were salvaged for parts to repair the ''Omen'' and captured for use in the [[Sith armada (Lost Tribe of the Sith)|Sith fleet]]. In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], the Tribe [[Codex|felt]] the presence of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], and Ship was forced to leave the Tribe by the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[Destructors|entity]] [[Abeloth]]. The Tribe thus sent a [[Lost Tribe of Sith strike team|strike team]] under [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lady]] [[Olaris Rhea]] to recover Ship and [[Death/Legends|kill]] Skywalker. The [[Skirmish at Sinkhole Station|mission]] went poorly; Ship remained in Abeloth's control, and the strike team's sole survivor was Rhea's [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Vestara Khai]].

Lord [[Viun Gaalan]] led the mission to recover Khai, who had fled to the planet [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. Gaalan [[Skirmish in the Dathomir landing meadow|captured]] several [[Darksider|dark side]]-wielding [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] from the world, but Skywalker, his son [[Ben Skywalker|Ben]], and the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Dyon Stadd]] [[Duel in the Dathomir landing meadow|forced]] him to flee. The Jedi captured Khai, but before they could leave Dathomir, they were stopped by a Tribe [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] led by [[High Lord (Circle of Lords)|High Lord]] [[Sarasu Taalon]], who proposed an alliance to confront Abeloth&mdash;who was causing a [[Force psychosis|psychosis]] amongst the Jedi. The alliance held together until they [[Mission to the Maw|battled]] Abeloth, and the Tribe betrayed the Jedi and tried to capture the entity. The Jedi nevertheless survived, and Luke Skywalker appeared to kill Abeloth. The Tribe repaired their alliance with the Skywalkers to learn more about Abeloth, but when they discovered that she had actually survived, the alliance again [[Duel at the Pool of Knowledge|fell apart]].

The Tribe then hunted the Jedi and Abeloth to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Pydyr]], where another [[Battle in the Fallanassi village|battle]] left Taalon dead. Soon afterward, [[Sith Saber]] [[Gavar Khai]] arranged a [[Jedi Queen project|project]] to prevent the culmination of a [[Throne of Balance|vision]] that Taalon had seen of a [[Allana Djo Solo|Jedi queen]] who could prevent the Tribe's rise to power; but the plan ultimately failed. Meanwhile, Gavar Khai led [[Operation Shieldfall]] to kill or capture Abeloth and eliminate the Skywalkers on the planet [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]], but the Jedi defeated the Sith there. Afterward, Abeloth feigned an alliance with the Tribe and traveled to the Kesh [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]], [[Tahv]], where she attempted to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] the Sith [[Grand Lord]] [[Darish Vol]] and proceeded to [[Destruction of Tahv|destroy]] the city itself. As she fled, several of the Tribe led by Khai deserted and joined [[Abeloth's fleet]]; however, Khai was soon after [[Duel on Dromund Kaas|killed]] by his daughter.

The Jedi then left the galactic capital [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] on a [[Mission to Upekzar|mission]] to destroy Abeloth that ultimately failed. Meanwhile, the Tribe infiltrated Coruscant, but Abeloth killed Vol and forced the Tribe on the capital to assist her in becoming [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]]. The Jedi returned to [[Liberation of Coruscant (Lost Tribe of Sith emergence)|liberate]] Coruscant, [[Duel in Kameron Suldar's office|killing]] High Lord [[Ivaar Workan]] and several others before the Tribe retreated into the [[New Jedi Temple]] at Abeloth's behest. The Jedi's [[Assault on the New Jedi Temple|assault]] on the Temple was foreseen by Abeloth and was initially a failure, resulting in Abeloth's capture of Vestara Khai and Ben Skywalker. She tried to convince them to turn into beings like her&mdash;known as [[The Ones/Legends|the Ones]]&mdash;but they [[Duel at the Font of Power|killed]] Abeloth, while her other bodily manifestations were also [[Duel at the Lake of Apparitions|killed]]. Meanwhile, the Tribe on Coruscant were finally forced from the Temple, hunted down throughout the planet, and defeated.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|It was our destiny to land on this rock&mdash;and we are bound to our destiny. For a time, it looks like, we're also bound to this rock. So be it. We're Sith. Let's make it ours.|[[Yaru Korsin]], first Grand Lord of the Lost Tribe of Sith|<ref name="Prec">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Precipice]]''</ref>}}
In [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], the [[Sith dreadnaught]]s ''[[Omen]]'' and [[Harbinger (Sith dreadnaught)|''Harbinger'']] were sent on a mission to procure powerful [[Lignan crystal]]s&mdash;[[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|lightsaber crystals]] made of the rare [[Lignan]] [[Ore/Legends|ore]]&mdash;for use by the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] in the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]. However, they were ambushed by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Relin Druur]] and [[Drev Hassin]], and in the ensuing [[Skirmish over Phaegon III|skirmish]], both [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Starship/Legends|vessels]] attempted to flee into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].<ref name="CC">''[[Crosscurrent]]''</ref> The two ships collided as the ''Omen''{{'s}} [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] engaged, knocking them both off course. The ''Omen'' came out of hyperspace very close to the remote [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]],<ref name="Prec" /> where it crash-landed in a [[Takara Mountains|mountain range]]. The vessel's communications devices were rendered useless, and the world&mdash;home only to the technologically primitive [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] [[Species/Legends|species]]&mdash;did not contain the materials needed to rebuild the ''Omen''.<ref name="Sky">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Skyborn]]''</ref> The Sith who survived the crash thus took control of the world from the Keshiri and set up a new [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Tribe]], ruled by a [[Grand Lord]] and a council called the [[Circle of Lords]]. They made the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Tahv]] their [[Capital/Legends|capital]] and built a [[Kesh Sith Temple|Sith Temple]] over the preserved wreckage of the ''Omen''.<ref name="Omen" />

==The emergence==
===A new armada===
[[File:Vestara-parang.jpg|thumb|left|185px|Vestara Khai, during the Sith Tribe's first mission offworld]]
{{Quote|When Ship came to us with the news of the near extinction of the Sith, we did not fall victim to despair. We acted. Vessel by vessel, we are assembling a fleet with which we will eventually take back the galaxy from the Jedi, who spread like vermin throughout system after system.|Lady Olaris Rhea|<ref name="Omen" />}}
The Lost Tribe survived for over 5,000 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] in isolation on Kesh until the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], when, in [[41 ABY]], the [[Sith Meditation Sphere]] [[Ship (Sith Meditation Sphere)|Ship]] found the Tribe. Ship informed the Tribe of the happenings of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] since the ''Omen''{{'s}} accident, including the Sith Empire's failure in the Great Hyperspace War, the collapse of another [[Order of the Sith Lords|Sith Order]], and the renewed dominance of the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]] in the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. The Sith Tribe thus decided to use Ship in the rebuilding of a brand new [[Sith armada (Lost Tribe of the Sith)|Sith armada]] to serve the Tribe in an invasion of the galaxy.<ref name="Omen" />

On the first mission, Ship took [[High Lord (Circle of Lords)|High Lord]] [[Sarasu Taalon]], [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lady]] [[Olaris Rhea]], Lord [[Ivaar Workan]], [[Sith Saber]] [[Ruku Myal]], and Rhea's [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Vestara Khai]]&mdash;Khai being the first person on Kesh who had been contacted by Ship&mdash;to attack a [[Damorian Repair Yard|Damorian]] [[s18 light freighter]] and salvage it for parts to begin repairs on the ''Omen''. They [[Skirmish near Eriadu|ambushed]] the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], slaughtered the crew, and brought the vessel's parts back to Kesh.<ref name="First" /> The Tribe continued its attacks on various vessels, leaving none of their victims alive, until the ''Omen'' was successfully repaired, at which point they turned their efforts toward the capture of intact ships.<ref name="Omen" /> The Tribe also built a [[Tahv spaceport|spaceport]] for their [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] at Tahv,<ref name="Asc" /> and by [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], the armada numbered greater than two dozen vessels.<ref name="Omen" />

In that year, the Jedi [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] came into contact with a powerful [[Relics|object]], the [[Codex]], which magnified his presence in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. The Tribe then decided to send a [[Lost Tribe of Sith strike team|strike team]] to [[Death/Legends|eliminate]] the Grand Master in order to pave the way for their invasion. While that plan was being discussed, however,<ref name="Omen" /> Ship's will was overcome by [[Abeloth]]<ref name="Abyss" />&mdash;a powerful dark side [[Deity/Legends|deity]] who periodically [[Destructors|destroyed]] civilizations throughout the galaxy<ref name="Apoc" />&mdash;and the Meditation Sphere abruptly deserted the Tribe. The strike team was thus given the task of tracking down and recovering Ship before killing Skywalker.<ref name="Omen" />

===The strike team===
[[File:Luke_Skywalker_EA.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Jedi Grand Master Luke Skywalker]]
{{Quote|Luke Skywalker has done much to fight the Sith, the dark side. He was at one point the last Jedi, and now he has re-created the Order with hundreds of them. And now, somehow, he has broadcast his presence into the Force. And we can take him down.|Lady Olaris Rhea|<ref name="Omen" />}}
The strike team embarked on their mission aboard a captured [[Warship/Legends|warship]], the ''[[Eternal Crusader]]''. To the Tribe's surprise, Ship allowed Vestara Khai&mdash;who accompanied her Master, Rhea, and several others on the mission&mdash;to track the Meditation Sphere. Though the Tribe were suspicious of a trap, they decided to continue on their task regardless, and finally arrived at a [[Abeloth's planet|planet]] in [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]]. There, a group of the Tribe went planetside to retrieve Ship; however, they were unable to find the vessel, and the planet's dangerous [[Plant/Legends|flora]] and fauna began taking its toll on the strike team's numbers. Soon, the Sith also encountered Abeloth, who claimed to have been stranded on the world for the past thirty years. While she pretended to help the Tribe in their search for Ship, she actually forced the Meditation Sphere to stay out of their possession. At one point, Abeloth attempted to use her control over the world to drown Rhea, but Khai successfully saved her Master. After the incident, Khai was able to see through Abeloth's apparently [[Human/Legends|Human]] appearance&mdash;in reality, she possessed a much more [[Alien/Legends|alien]] form. The strike team continued [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttling]] down reinforcements from the ''Eternal Crusader'' until there was no one left aboard the warship.<ref name="Abyss" />

Meanwhile, [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]] [[Yuvar Xal]] had grown weary of Rhea's leadership and planned a coup against her. Before he could carry it out, however, Abeloth finally allowed Ship to return to the Sith, as she had learned of the presence of Skywalker&mdash;as well as his son, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ben Skywalker]]&mdash;aboard the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Sinkhole Station]] in the Maw. Abeloth instructed the Sith to capture the Skywalkers and take them back to Kesh. Ship then took the surviving members of the strike team&mdash;which had been whittled down to approximately fifteen Sith&mdash;to the station, where Rhea changed the objective back to eliminating the Jedi. They [[Skirmish at Sinkhole Station|ambushed]] the Skywalkers, but their attack went poorly. Xal attempted to execute his coup in the middle of the fighting, and he and his [[Ahri Raas|apprentice]] were killed, along with the rest of the strike team excepting Khai,<ref name="Abyss" /> who managed to flee to the planet [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]].<ref name="lash">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Backlash]]''</ref>

===The alliance===
{{Quote|We have a common cause.''"<br />"''Are&mdash;are you suggesting we form an alliance?''"<br />"''Precisely.|High Lord Sarasu Taalon and Grand Master Luke Skywalker|<ref name="Allies" />}}
Desperate to learn the identity and origin of their dark side assailants, the Skywalkers tracked Khai to Dathomir, where they found her under the protection of the native [[Witches of Dathomir|Dathomiri Witches]], who&mdash;unaware of her Sith origins and intentions of betrayal&mdash;had adopted her into their [[Raining Leaves Clan|Clan]]. Meanwhile, Khai had sold the [[Bright Sun|vessel]] in which she had escaped in order to send a [[Hypercomm/Legends|hypercomm]] message back to her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], informing the Tribe of the strike team's destruction and her survival. She also made an arrangement with a group of local [[darksider]]s known as the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] to meet with members of her Tribe and exchange [[Force power/Legends|techniques]], although in reality she intended for the Nightsisters to be captured by her Tribe.<ref name="lash" />

[[File:LukeSkywalkerAndGavarKhai-Allies.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Luke Skywalker and Gavar Khai]]
Lord [[Viun Gaalan]] led a contingent of Lost Tribe planetside to [[Skirmish in the Dathomir landing meadow|capture]] the Nightsisters and retrieve Khai, but before he could leave with the Sith apprentice, the Skywalkers and their [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] ally [[Dyon Stadd]] arrived and [[Duel in the Dathomir landing meadow|attacked]] the Tribe. Gaalan was forced to flee without Khai, who was subsequently captured by the Jedi. Her treachery revealed to the Witches, they banished Khai from their Clan. However, as the Jedi took her offworld,<ref name="lash" /> they were confronted in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] by a large fleet of [[ChaseMaster]] [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]] commanded by High Lord Sarasu Taalon. To the Jedi's surprise, Taalon proposed an alliance to travel into the Maw and confront Abeloth&mdash;who had been inducing a [[Force psychosis|psychosis]] amongst the Jedi Order's Knights. The Skywalkers were forced to reluctantly agree, although they did not trust the Tribe&mdash;indeed, the Tribe planned not to kill Abeloth as Taalon suggested, but to capture her for their own use and then kill the Jedi.<ref name="Allies" />

In order to keep some amount of leverage, Luke Skywalker convinced Taalon to let him keep Khai aboard his own vessel, the ''[[Jade Shadow]]''&mdash;despite the fact that Khai's [[Parent/Legends|father]], the Sith Saber [[Gavar Khai|Gavar]], was amongst Taalon's forces&mdash;as well as to meet up with his friend, businessman [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], who could assist them in navigating the Maw. They agreed to meet Calrissian at the planet [[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine]]; however, while there, Taalon became fascinated by the planet's [[wintrium]] [[Fountain of Ancients|Fountain of the Hutt Ancients]], and he ordered two of his vessels to obtain a sample of the wintrium. They [[Violation|desecrated]] the sacred fountain and were abruptly captured by [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] forces; the crew of [[Starstalker|one frigate]] was condemned to death, while the crew of the [[Winged Dagger|other]] was allowed to go free. Nevertheless, the Violation, as it was called, led to a crisis between the [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinians]] and the Hutts&mdash;who were bound by [[Treaty of Vontor|treaty]] to protect the fountain&mdash;and ultimately an [[Liberation|uprising]] against the Hutts.<ref name="Allies" /> The uprising went on to inspire several other [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] revolts across the galaxy.<ref name="Vortex" />

Meanwhile, the main fleet had left Klatooine, as both Taalon and Grand Master Skywalker had begun to feel restless, and Calrissian&mdash;who was accompanied by Jedi Knight [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]]&mdash;caught up to the fleet just outside the Maw. Luke Skywalker convinced the Sith to stop first at Sinkhole Station, because that was where he and his son had first encountered Abeloth shortly before the strike team's ambush. However, upon their arrival they found that it had been demolished. One Sith vessel flew too close to the wreckage and was destroyed, despite the efforts of Calrissian and his [[Colossus I Beta Series asteroid tug|asteroid tug]]. The fleet then moved on to Abeloth's planet, where Vestara Khai and Ben Skywalker&mdash;both of whom had flown in Ship before; the latter during the Second Galactic Civil War&mdash;sensed Ship's presence, and the allies landed to search for Abeloth.<ref name="Allies" />

[[File:Jaina_Apocalypse.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Jedi Knight Jaina Solo]]
Luke Skywalker led Taalon, Gavar Khai, and Lost Tribe [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Leeha Faal]] to the realm of the Force known as [[beyond shadows]] to try and locate Abeloth. However, while there, Faal fell into the [[Depths of Eternity]]&mdash;from which no one could be saved or retrieved&mdash;much to Taalon's fury. Soon afterward, Skywalker saw his deceased [[Marriage/Legends|wife]], [[Mara Jade Skywalker]], in the [[Lake of Apparitions]], and she convinced him that they had to leave the realm immediately. Meanwhile, Vestara Khai tricked Stadd, who had recently fallen prey to Abeloth's psychosis, into believing that she and the Sith were on his side, and she released him from his captivity aboard the ''Jade Shadow''. The Jedi and Sith tracked Stadd via a [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing beacon]] placed on him by Vestara to a [[Abeloth's cave|cave]], where they found him near death. He awoke and revealed that Abeloth had begun to drain his life energy, freeing him from the psychosis, and that she had fled down a tunnel upon sensing the allies' approach.<ref name="Allies" />

The allies found Abeloth and [[Mission to the Maw|attacked]] her, while Jaina Solo [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] her [[StealthX]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] in [[Starfighter combat/Legends|combat]] against Ship. During the battle, the Sith finally turned on the Jedi. Nevertheless, Ben Skywalker was able to hold off Gavar Khai in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|combat]] while the elder Skywalker fought Abeloth and the rest of the Tribe attempted to [[Control web|capture]] the entity. Despite the Sith's efforts, the Jedi Grand Master defeated and appeared to kill the entity; and Ship immediately fled from Solo. The Sith and Jedi then agreed to temporarily reinstate their alliance in order to investigate more into Abeloth and her origins. Calrissian, Solo, and the entire Sith fleet were sent offworld, leaving just Taalon, the Khais, and the Skywalkers to investigate.<ref name="Allies" /> However, the Sith [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotaged]] Calrissian's [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] tug, sending it on a course toward the gaseous [[Ashteri's Cloud/Legends|Ashteri's Cloud]] rather than the galactic capital planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. An s18 light freighter and three [[BDY crew skiff]]s crewed by Sith forces entered combat with Solo in her StealthX, but she managed to hold the Sith off long enough to flee with Calrissian into hyperspace. Upon Solo's return to Coruscant, the [[Jedi High Council (New Jedi Order)|Jedi High Council]] scrambled to respond to the Sith threat, but [[Siege of the New Jedi Temple|contention]] between the Jedi and the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]] delayed Jedi reinforcements from launching.<ref name="Vortex" />

===Pool of Knowledge===
{{Quote|I understand your suspicions, Master Skywalker. But this time, I ''do'' intend to kill Abeloth. I have seen what she can do, and I'm no more eager to see her loose in the galaxy than you are.''"<br />"''No. You don't understand what's happening to you, and Abeloth is the only one who knows. She's the only one who can tell you what you're becoming.|Sarasu Taalon and Luke Skywalker|<ref name="Vortex" />}}
[[File:Ben-Ascension.jpg|thumb|left|165px|Ben Skywalker]]
The tenuous allies soon discovered that Abeloth was not actually dead<ref name="Vortex" />&mdash;she had possessed Stadd's body in addition to her own, so Grand Master Skywalker had actually only killed the one of Abeloth's bodies.<ref name="Apoc" /> Nevertheless, Abeloth was weakened by the loss of one of her bodily manifestations, and she did lose control over the psychosis of the Jedi Knights on Coruscant. However, the being whom the Skywalkers and the Tribe had thought was Stadd and whom they had left to recover from his injuries aboard the ''Jade Shadow'' was actually Abeloth, and by the time they returned to the vessel she had already escaped. In their ensuing search for her they came up empty-handed, until they finally spoke with Ship, who directed them to the [[Pool of Knowledge]], a powerful [[Vergence/Legends|Force nexus]] on the world&mdash;unbeknownst to them, Ship had already fallen under Abeloth's influence once again. Despite the Jedi's reluctance, the Sith insisted on finding the Pool. Once there, Taalon viewed a [[Allana Djo Solo|Jedi queen]] on the [[Throne of Balance]] in the Pool, and fearing that she might prevent the Sith from coming to power, he ordered that the Jedi tell him who she was. They declined, and a [[Duel at the Pool of Knowledge|duel]] quickly broke out. No deaths were suffered on either side and the Jedi escaped; however, during the fight, Taalon jumped into the Pool, and afterward he slowly began to transform into the same kind of being as Abeloth. Meanwhile, Abeloth herself had returned to the Sith and Jedi vessels, commandeered the ''Jade Shadow'', and fled the world.<ref name="Vortex" />

Taalon and Gavar Khai decided to beat the younger Khai and send her to [[Spy/Legends|spy]] on the Jedi, ordering her to pretend that they had attacked her in punishment and that she was trying to escape. The elder Skywalker saw through the plan, but he agreed to take her along nonetheless. She and the Jedi tracked Abeloth to Pydyr, where the young Khai managed to send a message to her Tribe, informing them of Abeloth's whereabouts. Taalon and Gavar Khai quickly arrived with a large contingent of Sith, and Taalon offered the Jedi another alliance, promising to kill Abeloth&mdash;Luke Skywalker knew that Taalon just wanted to learn more about what he was becoming, but he was forced to accept the offer due to the Sith's overwhelming numbers. In the ensuing [[Battle in the Fallanassi village|battle]], numerous Sith were killed due to [[White Current/Legends|illusions]] projected onto them by Abeloth, Taalon was killed by Vestara Khai, who knew that she could not allow a second Abeloth to come into existence, and Abeloth again escaped&mdash;although the Jedi killed [[Akanah Norand Goss Pell|another]] of her bodily manifestations.<ref name="Vortex" />

The remaining Tribe attempted to take the Skywalkers into custody, and when the Sith learned that the young Khai had killed Taalon, they assumed she had turned traitor. She decided to assist the Skywalkers in fleeing from the Tribe's forces, and they escaped as a large wing of Jedi StealthX reinforcements arrived after finally launching from Coruscant. The Jedi arrivals dominated the Tribe forces, and Vestara Khai and the Skywalkers immediately continued tracking Abeloth.<ref name="Vortex" /> The entity set up an [[Skirmish in Meliflar Station|ambush]] for them by a group of [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] at the space station [[Meliflar Station]], but to no avail. Khai secretly sent her father a message when they ultimately located Abeloth on the planet [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]], and he led the Sith fleet to the planet in [[Operation Shieldfall]]. Shortly before the operation commenced, Sith Saber [[Tola Annax]] took a contingent of Sith planetside to ambush the Jedi. Annax's [[First duel in Kesla Vein|two]] [[Second duel in Kesla Vein|attacks]] failed; but the Tribe soon afterward located Abeloth at a [[Crystal Valley pumping station|pumping station]] in the town of [[Crystal Valley]].<ref name="Con" />

[[File:Vestara-Ascension.jpg|thumb|right|175px|Vestara Khai]]
Meanwhile, Gavar Khai had developed the [[Jedi Queen project]], wherein a group of Tribe led by Saber [[Querdan Dei]] were tasked with hunting down and killing the Jedi queen that Taalon had seen in the Pool of Knowledge. The Tribe discovered that the likeness of [[Tenel Ka Djo]], the [[Queen Mother]] of the [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]], closely resembled the Jedi queen, and they set about a plot to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] her to prevent her from giving birth to the queen in the future. However, they put their plan into motion while Djo was on a [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomatic]] [[mission to Klatooine]], and the project was disturbed by the interference of the prophesied queen, who had actually been born [[36 ABY|years previously]]&mdash;Djo's daughter, Allana Solo. The girl was able to delay the Sith long enough for her adopted mother, Jedi Knight [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], to arrive. Organa Solo engaged Dei in a duel and killed him,<ref name="Con" /> and the Jedi Queen project was temporarily abandoned.<ref name="Asc" />

On Nam Chorios, the Tribe finally located and attacked Abeloth, who was already weakened from contention with the Jedi&mdash;who had defeated the entity by forcibly [[Mnemotherapy|withdrawing]] from her another [[Callista Ming|one]] of the beings she had previously consumed, after which [[Nenn|another]] of her consumed victims committed suicide. The Tribe went on to surround Vestara Khai and the Skywalkers, but before they could kill the Jedi, the young Khai killed a [[tsil]]&mdash;a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]]&mdash;resulting in a massive [[death convulsion]] in the Force that incapacitated all of the Jedi and Sith in the area. She and the Skywalkers recovered before their Sith assailants, and they fled the pumping station. Meanwhile, the Sith fleet, commanded by Gavar Khai, was ambushed by the Jedi StealthX wing&mdash;which had been in hiding in the [[Star system/Legends|system]] at Grand Master Skywalker's orders in anticipation of the arrival of Sith reinforcements. The Jedi forces, including Jaina Solo's [[Gray Squadron (New Jedi Order)|Gray Squadron]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kyle Katarn]]'s [[Gold Squadron (New Jedi Order)|Gold Squadron]], and the supporting [[White Squadron]], again easily defeated the Tribe. Gavar Khai was forced to call a retreat, and Abeloth narrowly escaped from the Jedi in Ship.<ref name="Con" />

===Devastation of Tahv===
{{Quote|To imagine, even for a moment, that anything human could even conceive of the vastness that is Abeloth, let alone trap me for your own tiny-minded purposes. Now you shall die, and your world shall become mine.|Abeloth, to Darish Vol|<ref name="Asc" />}}
Afterward, Abeloth contacted Saber Khai and proposed an alliance with him to take down the Jedi. He agreed, and upon conference with Grand Lord Vol and the Circle of Lords on Kesh, they approved of the idea as well. The Sith planned large festivities at their capital city of Tahv in order to celebrate Abeloth's arrival; although Khai found his loyalties caught in between the [[Politics/Legends|political]] maneuvering of Abeloth and Vol before the celebrations even began. When Abeloth was brought planetside, she took part in the arranged festivities; however, that evening, she decided to stage an [[Destruction of Tahv|attack]].<ref name="Asc" />

[[File:Tahv.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Kesh's capital city, Tahv]]
She appeared to the Grand Lord Vol in his sleep and attempted to kill him. However, she maneuvered too recklessly, allowing him to infiltrate her mind. He discovered her desperate loneliness and need for adoration and he mentally dueled her, telling her that she was not loved. Abeloth's assassination attempt turned into a frantic fight to free herself from Vol's grasp, and she finally broke away, leaving Vol weak and in agonizing pain. He quickly told his [[Aide/Legends|aide]], [[Revar]], to help him to his vessel and to warn the Tribe of Abeloth's betrayal, but it was too late. Abeloth was anguished and infuriated, and she discharged wave after wave of destructive dark side Force energy upon the city of Tahv in her torment, killing thousands of its inhabitants and leaving the city burning and in ruins.<ref name="Asc" />

Abeloth quickly moved to flee in the Meditation Sphere Ship, but as she took off, several other frigates also launched from the spaceport. Gavar Khai, aboard his [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the ''[[Black Wave]]'', finally decided to abandon the Tribe and join Abeloth. He ordered that all vessels cover Abeloth's retreat, and he commanded that all those who declined his order or failed to answer were to be shot down. Officially a part of [[Abeloth's fleet]], the ''Black Wave'' kept Ship safe long enough to flee into hyperspace. Afterward, the Lost Tribe was forced to abandon their devastated capital. Though weakened, Vol survived the destruction, and he prepared for the next stage of the Sith's invasion of the galaxy. The Tribe forces under Abeloth's command served to distract the Jedi while she recovered. Gavar Khai and nine Sith Sabers under Abeloth's command found the Skywalkers, Jaina Solo, and Vestara Khai on the planet [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. After the Sabers were all killed in the ensuing [[Duel on Dromund Kaas|duel]]&mdash;including Gavar Khai at the hands of his daughter&mdash;Annax was made commander of Abeloth's fleet. Following the death of her father, Vestara Khai officially joined the Jedi Order under the tutelage of Luke Skywalker.<ref name="Asc" />

===Infiltration of Coruscant===
{{Quote|Dad&mdash;you ''gave Coruscant to the Lost Tribe''?''"<br />"''I laid a trap. That's quite a bit different. The Lost Tribe believes it has a destiny to rule the galaxy. What better way to take a huge step toward fulfilling that destiny than to infiltrate Coruscant?''"<br />"''Uh, Dad, you maybe forgot one little thing.''"<br />"''And that might be?''"<br />"''Sith have infiltrated Coruscant!|Ben and Luke Skywalker discuss the latter's plan to handle the Lost Tribe of Sith|<ref name="Asc" />}}
[[File:Coruscant_SWTOR_Deceived.jpg|thumb|right|180px|Galactic capital planet Coruscant]]
Meanwhile, several Sith forces began subverting the government on Coruscant. High Lord Ivaar Workan infiltrated the [[Galactic Alliance Senate]] disguised as [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] "Kameron Suldar" and quickly gained prominence. Several Lost Tribe infiltrated various strategic positions within the Galactic Alliance, and others simply came to the planet itself in preparation for their move to take over the seat of government. Meanwhile, the Jedi Order left Coruscant at the orders of Luke Skywalker, who claimed that the Jedi needed to separate themselves from governmental affairs following their strained tensions with the recently [[Plan Delta|ousted]] Daala administration. He made the Order's departure a largely public ordeal, ensuring that the Tribe took it as a sign that they should put their plans into motion. Unbeknownst to the Tribe, he and the majority of the Jedi Order were embarking on a [[Mission to Upekzar|mission]] to the planet [[Upekzar]] to eliminate Abeloth and Ship, so that they could then return their focus to the Tribe&mdash;which would be gathered on Coruscant&mdash;and defeat the Sith all at once. However, the Jedi walked into a trap laid out by Abeloth&mdash;the entity had left Tola Annax on Upekzar as the focal point for a powerful Force explosion. Some of the Jedi were killed, although the majority managed to escape. During the mission, Vestara Khai killed Jedi Knight [[Natua Wan]] in order to ensure the life of Ben Skywalker, an act that made her realize she could never be a Jedi.<ref name="Asc" />

The Tribe indeed took the Jedi's departure as a sign to advance their plans, and began to send Sith into the [[New Jedi Temple|Jedi Temple]]. Meanwhile, they also arrested Organa Solo, the last Jedi on the planet. Workan reported to Vol that their plans were in motion; however, he also revealed that the new Senator [[Rokari Kem]] had suggested that she knew the truth about his identity&mdash;unbeknownst to the Sith, Abeloth had consumed Kem and come to Coruscant in the Senator's guise. Vol responded that he would come to Coruscant and kill Kem himself, and the Sith would then execute the final stages of their plan to take over the galaxy. However, when Vol arrived and went to assassinate "Kem," she overwhelmed and defeated him. Still disguised as Kem, Abeloth then contacted Workan and showed him the Grand Lord's head, ordering the High Lord to meet with her the next day.<ref name="Asc" />

She commanded Workan to initiate a vote to replace the current interim Chief of State, [[Padnel Ovin]], with herself. Workan called for the vote, but Ovin stalled with a lengthy speech&mdash;unbeknownst to the Sith, he was engaged in a plan to give [[Chief of Staff/Legends|Chief of Staff]] [[Wynn Dorvan]] and other allies of the Jedi time to free Organa Solo from her [[Prison/Legends|imprisonment]]. Finally, Abeloth used the Force to cause Ovin to collapse, and he quickly died. Using her powers to [[Mind trick/Legends|influence]] the Senators, Abeloth was able to win the vote, and she rose to power as Chief of State. She then came before Dorvan, who had been captured by three Trbie following Organa Solo's escape, and revealed her true form.<ref name="Asc" /> Soon after her rise to power, Abeloth&mdash;calling herself the "Beloved Queen of the Stars"&mdash;also took over the title of Grand Lord of the Tribe and commanded the Sith on the planet.<ref name="Apoc" />

===Endgame===
{{Quote|Surrender or die. Decide now.|The Jedi Order's message to the Sith on Coruscant|<ref name="Apoc" />}}
Once the Tribe had established themselves within the Senate, they began to take over other important administrations. Suspecting that the Jedi would soon return and infiltrate their way back into Coruscant, the Sith set themselves up as immigration inspectors. Vestara Khai, however, had predicted their move and forewarned the Jedi&mdash;who indeed returned to [[Liberation of Coruscant (Lost Tribe of Sith emergence)|liberate]] Coruscant&mdash;and the Jedi practiced concealing their lies and Force presences so the Sith would not detect them. The Jedi's efforts were further facilitated by members of [[Club Bwua'tu]], a secret government organization led by Admiral [[Nek Bwua'tu]] and his uncle, [[Eramuth Bwua'tu|Eramuth]]. Meanwhile, the Tribe on Coruscant served under Abeloth, who remained in disguise as Chief of State Rokari Kem. Abeloth ordered High Lord [[Korelei]] to [[Torture/Legends|torture]] Dorvan in an attempt to learn valuable information about the Jedi, but he withheld what important information he knew.<ref name="Apoc" />

[[File:TenelKaDjo_Conviction.jpg|thumb|left|135px|Tenel Ka Djo]]
The Jedi arrived aboard the [[Passenger liner/Legends|starliner]] ''[[Plain Lady]]'', fooling the Tribe inspectors on the vessel. As they passed through the immigration inspection stage in the [[Galactic Center Spaceport]], Sith Captain [[Suhale]] grew suspicious of Jedi Knights [[Yantahar Bwua'tu]] and [[Yaqeel Saav'etu]]. However, three nearby Knights, [[Bazel Warv]], [[Seff Hellin]], and [[Vaala Razelle]], helped Bwua'tu and Saav'etu escape the Tribe by pretending to be simple [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] in league with the two. Afterward, in an attempt to create [[Anti-Jedi sentiment/Legends|anti-Jedi sentiment]], the Tribe spread through the news that the Jedi were running a spice cartel. Meanwhile, elsewhere in the spaceport, Sith Master Ruku Myal recognized Vestara Khai, despite her disguise. When Myal activated his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], nearby [[Galactic Alliance Security]] [[Troop/Legends|troops]] assumed he was a Jedi and opened fire, and Khai killed the Sith Master with his own [[shikkar]]&mdash;a [[Glass/Legends|glass]] [[Dagger/Legends|dagger]]. The Jedi then sent a message across the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]], ordering the Sith to surrender or be killed. The Tribe refused to surrender, and the Jedi carried out myriad targeted assaults all across the planet, killing nearly 1,000 Sith. Among those killed were Master [[Jestat Vhool]], who was posing as a Galactic Alliance Security Superintendent; Saber [[Kayala Fei]], who was an announcer for [[BAMR News]]; and Ivaar Workan, who was killed in a [[Duel in Kameron Suldar's office|duel]] in his Senate office. Still, some of the targeted Sith did manage to escape, such as Lady [[Tela Rovas]], and about 5,000 Lost Tribe remained alive on Coruscant.<ref name="Apoc" />

Meanwhile, the Tribe launched a wing of [[GAT-12 Skipray Blastboat|Skipray twelve-jays]] to the planet [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] to ambush the [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|Jedi Academy]] there. Leia Solo and her husband, Captain [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], along with [[Hapan]] Queen Mother Tenel Ka Djo and Jedi Masters [[Tionne Solusar|Tionne]] and [[Kam Solusar]], led the [[Evacuation of Ossus (Lost Tribe of Sith emergence)|evacuation]] effort to save the [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiates]] and their families and transport them to the secret Jedi base on the planet [[Shedu Maad]] in the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]]. Four wings of Hapan [[Miy'til starfighter]]s helped defend the evacuating craft, but the [[Transport/Legends|transport]] [[Sharmok 718]] was boarded by Tribe and planted with a [[Baradium/Legends|baradium]] bomb. The Jedi and Hapan forces recognized that the vessel was behaving oddly and realized that the Tribe had boarded, but when the Hapan [[Volgh Squadron]] opened fire, the Sharmok exploded with a three-[[Kilometer/Legends|kilometer]] radius, killing all those aboard and destroying Volgh [[Squadron/Legends|Squadron]]. The Jedi realized that the blast had been intended to kill Tenel Ka Djo, whom the Sith still believed could be connected to the prophesied Jedi queen. During the mission, Allana Solo also had a [[Force vision/Legends|vision]] of the nest of [[Barabel/Legends|Barabel]] Jedi Knights [[Tesar Sebatyne]], [[Wilyem]], [[Zal]], and [[Dordi]] being attacked, and their [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]] being killed. Despite her earlier promise to the Barabels to keep the nest's location in the Jedi Temple a secret, she reported her vision, and the Solos traveled back to Coruscant to tell Jedi Knight Warv, who also knew of the nest.<ref name="Apoc" />

====Battleground Coruscant====
{{Main|Liberation of Coruscant (Lost Tribe of Sith emergence)}}
{{Quote|The Jedi attack us everywhere, and yet we have not been able to find ''them'' anywhere.|Lady Korelei, to Abeloth|<ref name="Apoc" />}}
Since the Jedi's advantage on Coruscant was due to their knowledge of the planet and of the Lost Tribe's positions, Abeloth and Korelei wanted to bring the fighting out into the open, where the Tribe&mdash;who greatly outnumbered the Jedi&mdash;could easily win. However, when Abeloth stopped torturing Dorvan and made him an aide to help her rule, he convinced her that the [[Coruscanti/Legends|Coruscanti]] people would not submit to Sith rule so easily; in reality, he hoped to protect civilians from being hurt by preventing the fighting from taking place in public. At Dorvan's suggestion, they instead agreed to withdraw all Sith forces into the Jedi Temple, where the Jedi would be forced to face them openly. After they pulled seventy-five percent of the Tribe on Coruscant into the Temple, Jedi Master [[Saba Sebatyne]] led several Jedi Knights, including [[Izal Waz]], on a perpetual hunt of the Tribe forces who remained outside. The Jedi and Club Bwua'tu recognized that the Sith withdrawal was a trap, and thus planned to launch an assault on the Temple from thirty points, hoping to draw the Tribe out to the perimeter while Luke Skywalker deactivated the Temple's [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] and the rest of the Jedi on the mission&mdash;who would take secret entrances into the Temple's center&mdash;could drive the Tribe to the exterior of the Temple.<ref name="Apoc" />

[[File:Corran_Horn_EA.jpg|thumb|right|145px|Master Corran Horn]]
The [[Galactic Alliance Marines]], commanded by Admiral [[Gavin Darklighter]], commenced their [[Assault on the New Jedi Temple|attack]], but the Jedi in the Temple were [[Quiet Return|ambushed]] by numerous Tribe who were aware of their plan&mdash;Abeloth had anticipated the Jedi battle plan and prepared the ambush. During the battle, Vestara Khai was knocked unconscious and captured by the Lost Tribe, and the Tribe forced the Jedi to retreat. Meanwhile, Luke Skywalker and Jedi Master [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] discovered that the computer interface they had hoped to use to override the lockdown of the Temple had been disabled, meaning that the Tribe had known about their assault well ahead of time. In the meantime, Abeloth had grown powerful enough to make use of multiple bodily manifestations at once&mdash;one as Chief of State Kem, one as the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] [[Lydea Pagorski]], one as the Temple's central core [[Computer/Legends|computer]] itself, and one as Lady Korelei.<ref name="Apoc" />

As the assault outside the Temple went on, inside the building Dorvan successfully stole a [[Hold-out blaster/Legends|hold-out blaster]] from Sith Master [[Tsiat]]. Then, when Abeloth&mdash;in the form of Rokari Kem&mdash;entered a trance, he shot the body multiple times, killing it. However, Abeloth quickly arrived on the scene in her true form and stopped Dorvan from committing suicide. Meanwhile, Jaina Solo and the Skywalkers, along with Horn, his children, [[Valin Horn|Valin]] and [[Jysella Horn|Jysella]], and Solo's [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]], [[Rowdy]], made their way to the Temple's computer core, where they hoped to lower the shields. Jysella found Dorvan in the core, but Abeloth kidnapped Ben and trapped Valin in an [[Airlock/Legends|airlock]]. Jysella managed to rescue both her brother and Dorvan, but since Abeloth controlled the computer, they were unable to complete their objective.<ref name="Apoc" />

Meanwhile, Vestara Khai had returned to consciousness and fled from the Tribe, but she was eventually cornered by High Lord [[Sashal]] and a group of the Tribe. Khai&mdash;who had recently deduced the identity of the Jedi queen, Allana Solo&mdash;told Sashal the girl's identity in an attempt to convince the Tribe that she was still on their side. Sashal then gave her a detonator and told her to complete her mission to kill the Jedi queen, revealing that the hatchway through which Khai had hoped to escape had finally opened, and Allana, Han, and Leia Solo were outside, along with Warv&mdash;with whom the Solos had met regarding Allana's vision. Khai threw the detonator, which connected with the Solos' ship, the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], but failed to kill Allana. In the ensuing combat, Warv was killed and the majority of the Tribe were slaughtered, but the three Solos escaped.<ref name="Apoc" />

====Abeloth's destruction====
{{Quote|Then Abeloth is truly dead?''"<br />"''As much as that is possible, yes.|Vestara Khai and Ship|<ref name="Apoc" />}}
[[File:Allana_Solo.jpg|thumb|left|160px|Allana Solo, the future Jedi queen]]
Abeloth in Pagorski's form traveled to the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]], where she hoped to cause disruption by assisting [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala]] in winning the first [[Imperial Election of 44 ABY|Imperial election]]. Meanwhile, the Jedi and their allies changed their objective to destroying the [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generators]] in order to send in [[Void Jumper]] marines, and Corran Horn, Jaina Solo, and Luke Skywalker succeeded in killing one of Abeloth's bodies in the form of Lady Korelei, while Abeloth's body in the form of Lydea Pagorski was simultaneously [[Raid on Hagamoor 3|destroyed]] on the planet [[Hagamoor 3]] by former Jedi [[Tahiri Veila]] and [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], at the behest of the Imperial [[Head of State (Imperial Remnant)|Head of State]] [[Jagged Fel]]. As such, the Jedi were able to take out the Temple's shields, allowing access to the interior of the Temple for the Void Jumpers. Meanwhile, Han, Leia, and Allana Solo battled the Lost Tribe through the Temple, meeting up with Jedi Knight [[Zekk]], the Hapan [[Taryn Zel]], and several Hapan [[Commando/Legends|commandos]], before they finally located the Barabel nest and warned them of Allana's vision.<ref name="Apoc" />

As the assault on the Temple went on, about 300 Lost Tribe fled the building and were hunted down through Coruscant by the Jedi. The Jedi Council convened&mdash;along with Darklighter, Nek and Eramuth Bwua'tu, Senator [[Luewet Wuul]], and other allies to discuss their next move, as well as to hear a report from Jedi Knights [[Lowbacca]] and [[Tekli]], who had learned the truth of Abeloth's nature from the [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]]&mdash;at least [[100,000 BBY/Legends|100,000 years]] previously, Abeloth had been a servant to a family of powerful [[Celestial/Legends|Force wielders]] called [[The Ones/Legends|the Ones]]. She swam in the Pool of Knowledge and drank from another Force nexus, the [[Font of Power]], resulting in her transformation into a member of the Ones; but one who sought to destroy. She had been imprisoned by the Ones, but the Ones had been [[Mission to Mortis/Legends|killed]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and the use of the [[flow-walking]] technique by Sith Lord [[Darth Caedus]] during the Second Galactic Civil War had finally set Abeloth free. While the meeting continued, Abeloth began to cause massive [[Groundquake/Legends|geologic activity]] on Coruscant, destroying numerous buildings, including the [[Galactic Justice Center]]. She then left Coruscant in Ship with Vestara Khai and Ben Skywalker, hoping to convince them to join her in forming a new family of the Ones.<ref name="Apoc" />

The Lost Tribe who remained on Coruscant were hunted down and defeated, although they&mdash;along with the remnants of Abeloth's seismic destruction&mdash;caused massive damage to the [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|city-planet]], resulting in civilian deaths estimated as high as in the billions. Jaina Solo and Luke Skywalker quickly launched in the vessel [[Rude Awakening (starship)|''Rude Awakening'']] after Ship, hoping to save both Khai and the young Skywalker from Abeloth. Meanwhile, Jagged Fel piloted the [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]] ''[[Parting Gift]]'' to pick up the Barabel Jedi, their younglings, the Solos, and their escort. The extraction was successful, and Master Saba Sebatyne, Tahiri Veila, and a unit of Void Jumpers led by [[Sergeant major/Legends|Sergeant Major]] [[Gef Olazon]] stayed behind on a mission to destroy the manifestation of Abeloth coupled to the Temple's core computer. Meanwhile, as Ben Skywalker and Vestara Khai resisted Abeloth's efforts to make them join her, Jaina Solo and Luke Skywalker contemplated whether or not it was the will of the Force for the young Khai and Skywalker to replace the Ones who had previously held Abeloth at bay.<ref name="Apoc" />

[[File:Abeloth.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Abeloth]]
As Solo confronted Ship in the Maw and began to [[Dogfight in the Maw|battle]] the Meditation Sphere, Luke Skywalker entered the realm beyond shadows and located Abeloth, [[Duel at the Lake of Apparitions|fighting]] her with the help of a [[Darth Krayt|Sith stranger]] from another [[One Sith|faction]] of Sith, even while Ben Skywalker and Vestara Khai [[Duel at the Font of Power|dueled]] Abeloth at the Font of Power. Sebatyne's team inside the Jedi Temple fought through many Sith, as well as [[Sith shadow-ghoul]]s created by Abeloth. Finally, they destroyed the computer core, forcing Abeloth's being out, and Sebatyne killed the entity. Meanwhile, Abeloth was also killed beyond shadows, as well as by Khai and Ben Skywalker on her planet in the Maw. With all of her bodily manifestations defeated at once, she was finally destroyed. Ship, who was at last completely freed from Abeloth's control, quickly fled from Solo.<ref name="Apoc" />

==Aftermath==
{{Dialogue|Skywalker|Tell me about the situation on Coruscant.|Dorvan|It's bad, but it's under control. The volcanic activity has stopped everywhere on the planet&mdash;though it will probably be years before we have even a basic survey of the damage to the undercity. The seismic activity team has identified over a hundred thousand sites that need investigation down there, and it's not always easy to tell whether we're looking for a magma well, a terrorist attack, or a building collapse.|Durron|Tell him about the death clouds.|Dorvan|That's right. Clouds of ash, poisonous gas, and toxic smoke are still spreading through the undercity. We think underweller casualties are huge. Luke, they could be in the billions already.|attr=Luke Skywalker, Wynn Dorvan, and Jedi Master [[Kyp Durron]] on the damage done to Coruscant by Abeloth and the Sith|src=<ref name="Apoc" />}}
[[File:Jaina_vs_Vestara.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Jaina Solo vs Vestara Khai]]
Luke Skywalker was severely weakened in his combat with Abeloth, but he also recognized the Lost Tribe stranger as the same man he had seen in his visions back before the Second Galactic Civil War&mdash;a man he had previously assumed to be the Sith Lord Darth Caedus. While in the Lake of Apparitions, the Grand Master spoke again with both his wife and Caedus, the latter of whom revealed that he had fallen to the dark side and acted as he had during the Second Civil War in order to prevent his own vision coming true&mdash;one with the Lost Tribe stranger on the Throne of Balance and Allana at his side. As the Grand Master remained in a [[Coma/Legends|comatose]] state, Solo piloted the ''Rude Awakening'' to pick up the young Khai and Skywalker. At first, she only allowed the young Jedi Knight on board, and she revealed to him Khai's attack on the Solos and betrayal of Allana's identity. Solo and Skywalker then went to find Khai, but she was retrieved by Ship before they could capture her. Khai believed that she could never go back to her Tribe on Kesh, and Ship revealed that there were other Lost Tribe in the galaxy who needed her help and could use her knowledge of the Skywalkers to their advantage.<ref name="Apoc" />

[[File:Headofstatefel.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Jagged Fel]]
Meanwhile, back on Coruscant, the last of the Lost Tribe had been hunted down, and the Galactic Alliance&mdash;with a recovered Wynn Dorvan in place as Chief of State&mdash;had a [[seismic activity team]] assess the massive damage done to the capital. Volcanic activity and groundquakes had ceased, but there were over 100,000 sites throughout the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]] that required examination. Furthermore, there was a great welling of clouds of [[Poison/Legends|poisonous]] gas throughout the city-planet. The public was abound with anti-Jedi sentiment due to the Sith's efforts over the BAMR network to convince the Coruscanti that the fighting was due to a war going on between a supposed Jedi spice cartel and their rival. As such, the Galactic Alliance Senate voted to remove the Jedi from Coruscant, with enough votes to override a veto from Dorvan. Upon the return of Jaina Solo and the Skywalkers, the Jedi Grand Master agreed that the Order's relocation was in the best interests of all involved, and the Jedi moved to their secret base on Shedu Maad. Meanwhile, the Solos decided that since Allana's identity was known by the Sith, there was no point in trying to keep it a secret any longer. During the [[wedding of Jagged Fel and Jaina Solo]], she was announced publicly as the [[Chume'da]], heir to the Hapes [[Consortium]].<ref name="Apoc" />

Soon after the defeat of the Lost Tribe on Coruscant, the Jedi received reports from Jedi Knights [[Sothais Saar]] and [[Avinoam Arelis]]&mdash;who were assisting enslaved populations in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] to win their freedom&mdash;that a tentacle had suddenly materialized from the Force and briefly assailed them. The Jedi realized that it was Abeloth starting the slow process of reforming her body, and thus decided that they needed to arm future generations against Abeloth's inevitable return. During Skywalker's [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] under [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] on the planet [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]], the Jedi Master had told him a story of the discovery of the Ones during the Clone Wars&mdash;Skywalker's father, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin]], and the Jedi [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] had found the world [[Mortis/Legends|Mortis]], where the Ones lived; and during the mission the Ones had been killed by the use of a [[Dagger of Mortis/Legends|Force-empowered dagger]]. Luke originally thought that the tale was untrue, but upon the revelations regarding Abeloth, he believed that if the Jedi could locate Mortis, they could find the dagger and with it kill Abeloth permanently upon her return. As such, he organized a group of [[Quest Knights|Ten Knights]] to search for the [[Mortis monolith/Legends|Mortis monolith]], the gateway to Mortis, to find the dagger.<ref name="Apoc" />

==Combatants==
===Lost Tribe of Sith===
{{Main|Lost Tribe of Sith}}
The Lost Tribe of Sith were the descendants of the survivors of the 5,000 BBY crash of the starship ''Omen'' on the planet Kesh. The accident occurred during the Great Hyperspace War, when the Sith had the intention of fighting for their Empire to take control of the galaxy.<ref name="CC" /> Due to the destruction of their vessel and equipment in the crash, the native Keshiri's lack of advanced technology, and the planet's lack of sufficient material to make repairs, the survivors were stranded on the remote world with no way to contact their fellow Sith.<ref name="Prec" /><ref name="Sky" /> As such, the Tribe held on to a desire to return to the galaxy and conquer it in the name of the Sith, a goal which they were eager to put in motion upon the arrival of Ship. With Ship to ferry them offworld,<ref name="Omen" /> the Tribe began working as [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] to build up their navy and achieve important strategical positioning for their fleet, which contained hundreds of vessels by [[44 ABY]].<ref name="Vortex" /> By the time of their emergence, the Sith Tribe numbered in the tens of thousands.<ref name="Apoc" />

The Sith were willing to go to extensive measures to attain their goals, including temporarily allying with their greatest enemies, the Skywalkers.<ref name="Allies" /> Although the Tribe suffered internal strife between rival members,<ref name="Omen" /> they were still capable of working together toward a common goal in large numbers, and they were taught to respect and obey their superiors.<ref name="Allies" /> Many of their number were susceptible to Abeloth's influence, however, causing their plans of galactic domination to stall. Furthermore, Abeloth's power was so great that she murdered the Tribe's Grand Lord and ultimately forced the other Sith to serve her purposes and assist in her rise to power.<ref name="Asc" /> Abeloth then took the title of Grand Lord for herself, and from that point forward, she used the Tribe to further her will. Abeloth was eventually destroyed, and the Jedi and Galactic Alliance forces defeated the Sith on Coruscant. Nevertheless, the location of their homeworld remained a secret, so the Sith who had stayed on Kesh were not immediately eradicated.<ref name="Apoc" />

===New Jedi Order===
{{Main|New Jedi Order}}
[[File:New_Jedi_Order.svg|thumb|right|165px|Insignia of the New Jedi Order]]
The New Jedi Order was formed by the Jedi Luke Skywalker<ref name="Out">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]''</ref> following [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|purge]] of the original [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="RS">{{Film|III}}</ref> By the time of the emergence, the New Jedi Order numbered approximately 1,000 to 1,500 Jedi in all.<ref name="Apoc" /> During the first two years of the Lost Tribe's activity of Kesh, the Jedi Order remained unaware of the Sith.<ref name="Omen" /> It was not until the strike team ambushed the Skywalkers at Sinkhole Station that the Jedi learned of the new threat,<ref name="Abyss" /> and even then, they were not certain of the nature of their assailants. Since Vestara Khai led them back to Dathomir, the Skywalkers even suspected briefly that their attackers were from that world. Furthermore, since two most recently dominant [[Lumiya's Sith|Sith Order]] had been dictated by the [[Rule of Two/Legends|Rule of Two]], the Jedi were surprised by the fact that the Tribe consisted of many more Sith. The Jedi were further hindered in their dealings with the Sith<ref name="lash" /> by the fact that Grand Master Skywalker had been put on [[The Galactic Federation of Free Alliances versus Luke Skywalker|trial]] in 43 ABY and [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] from Coruscant for allowing the Jedi Knight Jacen Solo to fall to the dark side and become Darth Caedus during the Second Galactic Civil War.<ref name="Out" /> The Grand Master was accompanied on his travels by his son, but he was not allowed any other form of contact with the Jedi Order.<ref name="lash" />

Furthermore, when the Jedi on Coruscant were made aware of the Sith threat, they were unable to mobilize due to their conflict with the administration of Chief of State Natasi Daala. When Jedi had begun to fall prey to Abeloth's psychosis, the government and the Jedi did not agree on who should be allowed to keep the psychotic Knights. Interim Grand Master [[Kenth Hamner]] was also very conservative in his leadership; he refused to allow the Jedi to launch their StealthX wing to help the Skywalkers on Pydyr because he feared that Daala would believe the launch was directed at her and would start an open war on the Order. Eventually, Hamner was killed in [[Skirmish in the Operations Hangar|combat]] with Jedi Master Saba Sebatyne after he tried to sabotage the launch of the starfighters.<ref name="Vortex" /> Sebatyne was then made interim Grand Master until Skywalker was granted pardon and allowed to return.<ref name="Con" /> Skywalker then led the entire Jedi Order off Coruscant for a mission to eliminate Ship and Abeloth, with the purpose of luring the Sith Tribe to Coruscant so that upon their return the Jedi could defeat the Sith in one operation.<ref name="Asc" /> Though the operation originally went poorly due to Abeloth's foresight, the Jedi eventually succeeded in defeating her and the Tribe. Much of Coruscant was devastated in the process, and public opinion&mdash;partially due to the efforts of the Sith infiltrators themselves&mdash;was turned sharply against the Jedi. As such, the Order was forced to leave the capital, and they relocated to their secret base on Shedu Maad.<ref name="Apoc" />

===Abeloth===
{{Main|Abeloth}}
At least 100,000 years before the emergence, Abeloth was a servant to the Ones&mdash;the powerful Force-wielding [[Father (Mortis)/Legends|Father]], [[Daughter/Legends|Daughter]], and [[Son/Legends|Son]]. She eventually came to be the Mother of the family, but she bathed in the Pool of Knowledge and drank from the Font of Power, turning her into a powerful dark side entity. She then became a [[Keshiri religion|legendary]] destroyer of civilizations, and the Ones imprisoned her; although she was periodically able to escape and bring chaos to the galaxy, her actions caused the Daughter and Son to work together and trap her. However, during the Clone Wars, the Father, Daughter, and Son were all killed, leaving no one to keep Abeloth in check.<ref name="Apoc" /> Abeloth was imprisoned on a planet in the Maw, where she was kept detained by Sinkhole Station. She was able to extend her reach over Force-sensitive beings who spent time in the Maw, causing them to develop a psychosis and yearn to find her. Those who came to her stayed at Sinkhole Station and become known as [[Mind Walkers]];<ref name="Allies" /> she routinely fed off of their life energies. Following the [[Battle of Centerpoint Station (Second Galactic Civil War)|destruction]] of [[Centerpoint Station]] in the Second Galactic Civil War, Sinkhole Station began to fall into disrepair, until finally, in 44 ABY, Abeloth was able to destroy Sinkhole.<ref name="Abyss" /><ref name="Allies" /> The constant warring between Jedi and Sith&mdash;and namely Darth Caedus' use of the flow-walking technique&mdash;ultimately caused Abeloth to be freed.<ref name="Apoc" /> Afterward, she was finally able to move offworld, although she was kept on the run by the Jedi and Sith who hunted her,<ref name="Vortex" /> preventing her from achieving her desire to become the "Beloved Queen of the Stars."<ref name="Asc" />

Her true nature remained a mystery to the Sith and Jedi for some time, although her actions were often dominated by the presence of the former Jedi Callista Ming, whom she had consumed. Ming, a former lover of Luke Skywalker, at times was able to influence Abeloth's actions and even prevent her from harming Skywalker. On Nam Chorios, the Grand Master finally extracted Ming's presence from Abeloth, allowing the former Jedi to die.<ref name="Con" /> Abeloth's hold on her psychotic followers was broken when she was severely weakened after her initial defeat to Skywalker on her prison world,<ref name="Allies" /> as well as following the removal of Ming's spirit.<ref name="Con" /> She finally resolved to have her Sith followers lead the Jedi astray, giving her time to gather her strength and take over the government on Coruscant.<ref name="Asc" /> She grew in power, taking command of the Sith forces on Coruscant and attaining the title of Grand Lord. She also quickly increased the number of bodily manifestations she wielded, consuming more and more beings&mdash;although the bodies of the non-Force-sensitives whom she consumed quickly wore out and required replacement. Finally, Saba Sebatyne, Tahiri Veila, and a group of Void Jumpers succeeded in destroying Abeloth's manifestation in the Jedi Temple's computer core, while Luke Skywalker and Darth Krayt&mdash;the Sith whom Skywalker recognized from his visions&mdash;killed another manifestation in the Lake of Apparitions beyond shadows, and Vestara Khai and Ben Skywalker killed another at the Font of Power. Before long, however, Abeloth started the slow process of reforming her body.<ref name="Apoc" />

===Galactic Federation of Free Alliances===
{{Main|Galactic Federation of Free Alliances}}
[[File:GA_Roundel.svg|thumb|right|165px|Galactic Alliance roundel]]
The Galactic Federation of Free Alliances became the leading galactic government following the collapse of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].<ref name="FH1">''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic I: Remnant]]''</ref> The Alliance was politically tied to the New Jedi Order; it included a [[High Council (Galactic Alliance)|High Council]] consisting of six Jedi and six members of the Alliance.<ref name="DW">''[[The New Jedi Order: Destiny's Way]]''</ref> The Alliance's first Chief of State was [[Cal Omas]],<ref name="FH1" /> who led the government through the [[Dark Nest Crisis]], the [[Swarm War]],<ref name="DN3">''[[Dark Nest III: The Swarm War]]''</ref> and part of the Second Galactic Civil War, which began with the secession of a [[Confederation]] led by the planet [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. During the war, Omas was ousted in a [[Solo-Niathal coup|coup]] by Jacen Solo and Admiral [[Cha Niathal]],<ref name="Sac">''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]''</ref> and the Alliance later came under the sole control of Solo. The Jedi Order, Hapes Consortium, [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]], [[Maw Irregular Fleet]], and the [[Alliance-in-exile]]&mdash;Galactic Alliance forces no longer loyal to Solo&mdash;formed a [[Coalition]] to [[Battle of Uroro Station|defeat]] the Alliance. After the war's end, Natasi Daala was elected as the Galactic Alliance's Chief of State.<ref name="Inv">''[[Legacy of the Force: Invincible]]''</ref>

While the Sith on Kesh prepared for their invasion,<ref name="Omen" /> Daala began to take measures against the Jedi Order, such as the arrest and exile of Luke Skywalker. As Jedi Knights began to fall prey to Abeloth's psychosis, Daala's policies against the Order grew stricter, resulting in her use of Galactic Alliance Security forces to capture the psychotic Jedi. She went on to hire Mandalorians to try and [[Skirmish at the Krabbis Inn|capture]] the psychotic Knights;<ref name="Abyss" /> and when the Order refused to cooperate with her, Daala authorized a Mandalorian [[Raid on the New Jedi Temple|raid]]<ref name="lash" /> and [[Siege of the New Jedi Temple|siege]] of the Jedi Temple.<ref name="Allies" /> Eventually, the Jedi ousted Daala and established the first [[Triumvirate (Galactic Alliance)|Triumvate]] of interim Jedi Grand Master Saba Sebatyne, Senator [[Haydnat Treen]], and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Merratt Jaxton]] in her place.<ref name="Con" /> Wynn Dorvan later replaced Jaxton, but when the Jedi Order announced that they were leaving Coruscant, the triumvirate was dissolved and [[Padnel Ovin]] was elected Chief of State. However, both the Sith and Abeloth had infiltrated the Galactic Alliance, and Abeloth murdered Ovin and became Chief of State.<ref name="Asc" /> During the liberation of Coruscant, Club Bwua'tu&mdash;a secret organization within the Alliance&mdash;Galactic Alliance Marines under the command of Gavin Darklighter, and several other government forces helped the Jedi eradicate the Sith and defeat Abeloth. After the crisis, Wynn Dorvan became the Chief of State.<ref name="Apoc" />

===Hapes Consortium===
{{Main|Hapes Consortium/Legends}}
[[File:Hapes_Consortium.svg|thumb|right|200px|Emblem of the Hapes Consortium]]
The Hapes Consortium was a matriarchal, hereditary monarchy based on the capital world [[Hapes/Legends|Hapes]] in the Hapes Cluster. Hapes was ruled by a Queen Mother, with an heir to the throne known as the Chume'da. Hapes was founded thousands of years<ref name="Temp">''[[Legacy of the Force: Tempest]]''</ref> before the Sith Tribe's invasion<ref name="Omen" /> by the [[First Queen Mother|first]] Queen Mother.<ref name="Temp" /> In [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]], Tenel Ka Djo, who was training as a Jedi, became the Queen Mother after the death of her mother, the Queen Mother [[Teneniel Djo]].<ref name="DJ">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Journey]]''</ref> Due to Tenel Ka Djo's ties to the Jedi Order, the Hapes Consortium remained a close ally of the Jedi for years; even after she resigned from the Order in [[36 ABY]] in order to focus more on her reign.<ref name="DN3" /> When her former lover, Jacen Solo, became the Sith Lord Darth Caedus and took control of the Galactic Alliance, Djo pledged the Hapan forces to a Coalition to defeat him. At the end of the war, after a [[nanovirus]] attack on the Hapan royal family, Tenel Ka Djo faked the death of her daughter, Allana Solo, in order to protect her.<ref name="Inv" />

The Hapes Consortium did not become actively involved in the war with the Sith until the Tribe discovered that she bore a striking resemblance to the Jedi queen that Sarasu Taalon saw on the Throne of Balance.<ref name="Con" /> Nevertheless, the Sith's attempts to assassinate Djo and Allana Solo failed. Later, Tenel Ka Djo led Hapan forces to help the Jedi in their evacuation from the Ossus Jedi academy, transporting them to a secret base on Shedu Maad in the Hapes Cluster itself. Furthermore, the Hapan Taryn Zel, accompanied by several Hapan commandos, assisted in the assault against the Sith in the Jedi Temple on Coruscant. Following the defeat of the Sith forces, Allana Solo's identity as Chume'da was revealed to the galaxy.<ref name="Apoc" />

==Key Sith figures==
===Darish Vol===
{{Quote|Nothing can hold her&hellip; Fool to think I could use her&hellip; What ''is'' she?&hellip; By the dark, the greatest mistake I have ever made&hellip;|Darish Vol, on Abeloth|<ref name="Asc" />}}
The Human [[Gender/Legends|male]] Darish Vol was the Grand Lord of the Lost Tribe of Sith. In that capacity, he was the Tribe's highest authority and most respected member during the time of the emergence. Along with Lady Rhea, he handpicked the first strike team sent to retrieve Ship and kill Skywalker.<ref name="Omen" /> Throughout the Sith's battles with the Jedi, Vol remained on Kesh to oversee the Tribe's activities at home.<ref name="Abyss" /><ref name="Con" /> When Abeloth was brought back to Kesh with the proposal of an alliance, he remained very wary of her; his fears were soon confirmed when she attacked him and laid waste to the city. Later, when the Sith stood poised to execute their coup of the government, he finally traveled to Coruscant. However, upon his arrival, Vol went to assassinate Rokari Kem, a Senator who High Lord Workan believed knew of the Sith plan. Kem was actually Abeloth in disguise, and she killed and beheaded Vol.<ref name="Asc" />

===Ivaar Workan===
{{Quote|From all that we have heard, she is unpredictable and dangerous. Only a fool rides the uvak he cannot control. I've no desire to continue to sacrifice Sith Sabers and Lords on the altar of aiding Abeloth and furthering her agenda&mdash;whatever it might be.|Ivaar Workan, on Abeloth|<ref name="Asc" />}}
Ivaar Workan was a Human male who had risen to the rank of Lord by 41 ABY.<ref name="Omen" /> He was one of the Sith selected to participate in the Tribe's first mission offworld, under the command of High Lord Sarasu Taalon.<ref name="First" /> Later on during the emergence, he remained on Kesh, where he became one of the few beings whom Darish Vol trusted not to betray him; and by 44 ABY he had achieved the rank of High Lord. Toward the final stages of the Sith's plans, Workan traveled to Coruscant, where he infiltrated the Senate disguised as "Kameron Suldar" from the planet [[B'nish]]. During his time on Coruscant, he uncovered a [[Lecersen Conspiracy|conspiracy]] plotting to take over the Galactic Alliance and helped to eliminate it, as it clashed with the Tribe's plans. He worked to pave the way for the Sith invasion, although his encounter with Rokari Kem made him uneasy. Indeed, his fears were confirmed when she killed Vol, and he learned she was actually Abeloth in disguise. Workan was then forced to assist her in her rise to the position of Chief of State.<ref name="Asc" /> Soon afterward, when the Jedi launched their mission to liberate Coruscant, Workan was a target assigned to Vestara Khai, Ben Skywalker, Luke Skywalker, and Jedi Knights [[Doran Sarkin-Tainer]] and [[Seha Dorvald]]. The five engaged in combat with Workan and three Sith guards in his Senate office, and Ben killed the High Lord with a blaster shot in the face.<ref name="Apoc" />

===Sarasu Taalon===
{{Quote|When our work together is done, I'm very much looking forward to killing ''you''.|Sarasu Taalon, to Luke Skywalker|<ref name="Vortex" />}}
[[File:Keshiri.jpg|thumb|left|150px]]
Sarasu Taalon was a male Keshiri who rose to the rank of High Lord and was active throughout much of the Tribe's emergence.<ref name="First" /><ref name="Vortex" /> He led the Sith on their first mission offworld with Ship,<ref name="First" /> and by 44 ABY had come into command of no fewer than eleven ChaseMaster frigates in the Sith armada. He convinced the Skywalkers to ally with the Sith and proceeded to command the Sith forces during their joint mission to confront Abeloth.<ref name="Allies" /> After that mission's failure, he remained onworld to learn more about Abeloth, and it was during the altercation in the Pool of Knowledge that he learned of the existence of a Jedi queen who could prevent the Sith's rise to power. Too, he dove into the Pool itself, and he began to transform into the same kind of being as Abeloth. He subsequently led Sith troops to Pydyr after learning of Abeloth's presence there, and again forced the Skywalkers to help him find Abeloth. However, upon confronting Abeloth, he showed a yearning to know more about what he was becoming as opposed to his supposed desire to kill her. Vestara Khai made use of a Jedi distraction to kill Taalon, as she believed she could not let another being like Abeloth come into existence.<ref name="Vortex" />

===Gavar Khai===
{{Quote|You have selected only the strongest and most powerful Sith for this mission. No one will fail you.|Gavar Khai, to Sarasu Taalon|<ref name="Allies" />}}
[[File:GavarKhai-Allies.jpg|thumb|left|150px]]
Gavar Khai was a Human male Sith Saber in the Tribe who rose to a level of prominence in the Sith forces during the emergence.<ref name="Con" /> He first served under Sarasu Taalon during their allied mission with the Jedi to confront Abeloth. Khai recognized his daughter's growing care for the younger Skywalker, and rather than discouraging it, he suggested that she use it to try and turn him to the dark side. During the Sith's betrayal of the Jedi, Gavar Khai turned the attack upon Luke Skywalker, although the younger Skywalker soon intervened and held the Sith Saber off.<ref name="Allies" /> Afterward, when they found that Abeloth had survived, Saber Khai suspected the Jedi of treachery on numerous accounts. He lost his forearm in the duel at the Pool of Knowledge,<ref name="Vortex" /> but he was eventually fitted with a [[Cybernetics/Legends|prosthetic]].<ref name="Asc" />

Khai again accompanied Taalon on the Sith mission to Pydyr, where he was the first Sith to hear that his daughter had killed Taalon.<ref name="Vortex" /> He remained unsure of his daughter's loyalties after the incident, although she messaged him to inform him of Abeloth's location on Nam Chorios. Saber Khai personally developed the Jedi Queen project, and he also led Operation Shieldfall to Nam Chorios&mdash;but both ventures ultimately ended in failure.<ref name="Con" /> Following Abeloth's destruction of Tahv, her influence on Khai finally won over, and he decided to defect from the Tribe. She sent him and several other Sith to lead the Jedi off her trail, and he was soon killed in a duel with his daughter.<ref name="Asc" />

===Vestara Khai===
{{Quote|We're on opposite sides of this thing, and maybe that makes us enemies. But we don't have to hate each other&mdash;that's a choice we make ourselves.|Vestara Khai, to Ben Skywalker|<ref name="Vortex" />}}
[[File:VestaraKhai-FOTJPoster.jpg|thumb|left|165px]]
The Human female Vestara Khai, at the time a [[Sith Tyro]], was the first being on Kesh whom Ship contacted&mdash;due to her ambition and aptitude. As such, she was honored by the Tribe and made the apprentice of Lady Olaris Rhea.<ref name="Omen" /> She was allowed to travel with Ship on the Sith's first mission in the emergence,<ref name="First" /> and she spent the next two years in the growing Sith armada.<ref name="Omen" /> She was chosen for the strike team's mission to recover Ship and kill the Skywalkers; the young Khai was the only Sith to see Abeloth's true form, and she was also the sole survivor of the skirmish with the Jedi.<ref name="Abyss" /> Afterward, the Sith apprentice used her skills and wits to survive and avoid capture by the Jedi by staying with the Witches of Dathomir.<ref name="lash" /> However, when the Jedi allied with the Sith, she was kept aboard the ''Jade Shadow'' for the mission,<ref name="Allies" /> and over time she began to develop a relationship with Ben Skywalker.<ref name="Asc" /> Her subsequent objective to spy on the Jedi following the duel at the Pool of Knowledge resulted in further travels with the Skywalkers, and when she killed Taalon she was forced to flee with the Jedi, knowing that her fellow Sith would not give her time to explain her actions. Though Vestara Khai still tried to assist her Tribe toward its ultimate goal in every way that she could, she was forced with increasing frequency into situations wherein she found herself helping the Skywalkers.<ref name="Con" />

Finally, after Khai was forced to kill her father in combat, and upon learning of the death of her [[Lahka Khai|mother]], she decided to officially rescind her Sith ways and join the Jedi. Nevertheless, after a mission in which she decided to kill another Jedi in order to ensure the safety of Ben Skywalker, she came to feel that she could never truly be a Jedi.<ref name="Asc" /> Vestara Khai thus decided to assist the Jedi against her Tribe in order to assure the deaths of all of the High Lords&mdash;who were duty-bound to kill her, since she had killed Taalon&mdash;before leaving the protection of the Order. She took part in the liberation of Coruscant and assisted the Jedi in killing High lord Ivaar Workan. She later revealed the identity of the Jedi queen to her Tribe in order to stop them from harming her, placing her in a situation wherein she was forced to betray and attack the Solos. Abeloth soon afterward offered Khai the title of "Daughter of the Night," a member of the Ones, irresistible and powerful. However, she ultimately refused, and helped Ben Skywalker kill Abeloth. Nevertheless, she knew he would not forgive her for betraying the Solos, so she fled in Ship. The Meditation Sphere promoted her to Sith Lord and informed her of a different faction of Sith that she could join.<ref name="Apoc" />

==Key Jedi figures==
===Luke Skywalker===
{{Quote|There are few enmities more ancient than that of Sith and Jedi.|Luke Skywalker|<ref name="Allies" />}}
[[File:Skywalker_Apocalypse.jpg|thumb|left|175px]]
