The Human male Luke Skywalker [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|fought]] with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> and New Republic against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]],<ref name="HE">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref> and he rebuilt the Jedi Order and led it through numerous crises<ref name="Out" />&mdash;including the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] War<ref name="TUF">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]''</ref> and the Second Galactic Civil War.<ref name="Inv" /> However, in 43.5 ABY he was exiled from Coruscant for failing to prevent Jacen Solo's fall to the dark side during the latter war. Accompanied by his son, Ben, the exiled Grand Master embarked on a quest to discover why Jacen Solo had fallen to the dark side.<ref name="Out" /> It was during their travels that the Skywalkers first encountered the Sith Tribe; they were initially uncertain of the identities of the darksiders,<ref name="Abyss" /> but quickly discovered that they were in fact Sith.<ref name="lash" /> When Taalon proposed an alliance, Skywalker realized he had no option but to grudgingly accept, despite the knowledge that it was only a matter of time before the Sith betrayed him.<ref name="Allies" />

The confrontations with Abeloth became more personal for the elder Skywalker when he discovered that she had consumed his former lover, Callista Ming,<ref name="Allies" /> although he eventually freed Ming's spirit from Abeloth on Nam Chorios.<ref name="Con" /> The Grand Master received numerous grievous injuries during his battles with Abeloth and the Sith,<ref name="Abyss" /><ref name="Vortex" /><ref name="Con" /> but he refused to take much time to heal, as he feared giving his enemies enough time to recuperate themselves.<ref name="Vortex" /> Finally, following Daala's removal from office, Skywalker's exile was lifted and he was allowed to return to Coruscant and resume command over the Jedi.<ref name="Con" /> He lured the Sith to gather on Coruscant by pretending to move the entire Order to another location, but the Jedi's subsequent mission to eliminate Ship and Abeloth was unsuccessful; and while they were gone from Coruscant, Abeloth became Chief of State.<ref name="Asc" />

The Grand Master then spearheaded the Jedi's mission to liberate Coruscant. After his son was kidnapped by Abeloth, he and Jaina Solo traveled to the Maw to confront the entity. The elder Skywalker decided to go beyond shadows to do so, and he was assisted there by a Sith stranger&mdash;one who he had seen in visions before, though he had previously assumed that the Sith in his visions was actually Caedus. He and the Sith were successful in destroying Abeloth, and though Skywalker was greatly injured and willing to allow himself to die, an apparition of his wife convinced him to survive. The Grand Master also achieved the objective of his original mission in discovering the reason for Caedus' fall to the dark side&mdash;he had seen the same Sith stranger on the Throne of Balance, alongside Allana Solo, Caedus' daughter with Tenel Ka Djo. Afterward, Luke Skywalker led the Jedi off of Coruscant to their new headquarters on Shedu Maad.<ref name="Apoc" />

===Ben Skywalker===
{{Quote|I'm going with you.|Ben Skywalker, after his father's exile|<ref name="Out" />}}
[[File:BenSkywalker_Atlas.jpg|thumb|left|150px]]
The son of Luke and Mara Jade Skywalker, Ben Skywalker was born during the Yuuzhan Vong War<ref name="EV2">''[[The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory II: Rebirth]]''</ref> and was present at [[Shelter]], where Abeloth gained her hold on numerous future Jedi Knights who later fell prey to her psychosis. However, he withdrew from the Force during his time there, so Abeloth was unable to hold sway over him.<ref name="Apoc" /> Ben Skywalker later took part in the Second Galactic Civil War, during which his Master, Jacen Solo, turned to the dark side, becoming Darth Caedus and [[Skirmish on Kavan|killing]] the young Skywalker's mother.<ref name="Sac" /> Ben Skywalker helped the [[Jedi Coalition]] win the war,<ref name="Inv" /> and when his father was put on trial and exiled, the young Jedi Knight insisted that he accompany the Grand Master on his travels.<ref name="Out" /> The younger Skywalker proved himself an asset to his father on numerous occasions,<ref name="Out" /><ref name="Omen" /> and helped the elder Skywalker defeat about fifteen Sith on Sinkhole Station.<ref name="Abyss" /> After locating Vestara Khai on Dathomir but being unable to take her into custody, the young Skywalker developed an attraction to her, which she reciprocated.<ref name="lash" /> Over the course of his travels with his father, Ben Skywalker's skills grew increasingly prominent, to the point that he was able to singlehandedly duel and defeat three Sith Sabers.<ref name="Asc" />

During the allied mission with the Sith to confront Abeloth in the Maw, his relationship with the young Khai strengthened,<ref name="Allies" /> and despite her numerous attempts to undermine the Jedi, Ben Skywalker grew more and more convinced that he could turn her to the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]].<ref name="Vortex" /> Throughout his travels with the Sith apprentice, the young Skywalker served as the primary advocate for his father to trust her to do the right thing.<ref name="Con" /> Finally, after she was forced to kill her own father in combat, Ben Skywalker comforted the young Khai and promised to help her become a Jedi.<ref name="Asc" /> The young Jedi Knight, alongside Vestara Khai, assisted in the liberation of Coruscant; Ben Skywalker himself killed High Lord Ivaar Workan early in the campaign. However, he was eventually captured by Abeloth, who tried to convince him and Khai to join her as members of the Ones, offering to make Skywalker the "Prince of Light." Ben Skywalker refused, and with Khai's help was able to defeat her. Upon learning soon afterward of Khai's earlier betrayal of the Solos, however, the young Jedi was very distraught; he and Jaina Solo attempted to capture her, but she escaped in Ship.<ref name="Apoc" />

===Jaina Solo===
{{Quote|If we can find Ship, then we'll find Abeloth. And if he's managed to escape her somehow, then he'll have sought out the Lost Tribe. We could find one or both of our targets by shifting the direction of our search to finding ''him'' instead of chasing ''them''.|Jaina Solo|<ref name="Asc" />}}
[[File:JainaSolo_EssentialAtlas.jpg|thumb|left|150px]]
Jaina Solo, daughter of Leia Organa Solo and Captain Han Solo, rose to the rank of Jedi Knight during the Yuuzhan Vong War, when she was also proclaimed by her uncle Luke Skywalker to be the [[Sword of the Jedi]].<ref name="DW" /> During the Second Galactic Civil War, she was forced to [[Battle of Uroro Station|kill]] her brother, Jacen Solo, after he turned to the dark side and became Darth Caedus.<ref name="Inv" /> During the time of the emergence, she found herself in a complicated relationship with Imperial Remnant Head of State Jagged Fel, made difficult due to their conflicting duties. After temporarily breaking off their engagement, Jaina Solo left the political tension on Coruscant between Daala and the Jedi Order in order to help the Skywalkers in their dealings with the Sith. She tracked them to Klatooine, where she met up with Lando Calrissian and eventually joined the allied Sith and Jedi fleet. While the Skywalkers and the Sith battled Abeloth, Solo piloted her StealthX in combat with Ship.<ref name="Allies" />

She later fought off an ambush by Sith pirates and returned to Coruscant to inform the Order of the true extent of the Sith threat.<ref name="Vortex" /> Later, when the Tribe commenced Operation Shieldfall, Jaina Solo led Gray Squadron in the ambush of the Sith forces. After Vestara Khai and the Skywalkers escaped from the Sith on the surface, Luke Skywalker joined Solo in Gray Squadron in pursuit of Ship and Abeloth. Though Ship was damaged, the Meditation Sphere managed to escape with Abeloth intact.<ref name="Con" /> Solo went on to join the Skywalkers and Khai aboard the ''Jade Shadow'' in their ensuing search for Ship on various Sith worlds.<ref name="Asc" /> Solo was later part of the Jedi strike team sent to liberate Coruscant, and during the assault on the Jedi Temple&mdash;when Solo, Luke Skywalker, and Master Corran Horn believed they would almost certainly die&mdash;the Grand Master promoted Solo to the rank of Jedi Master. Upon learning of Ben Skywalker's kidnapping, she and Luke Skywalker immediately launched after him, and she battled Ship once more in the Maw. Afterward, Solo married Jagged Fel, who had ceded his bid for election as Head of State of the Empire in order to ensure Daala's defeat in the same election.<ref name="Apoc" />

===Saba Sebatyne===
{{Quote|We're going to need a warrior leading the Order, and that's not me.|Jedi Master [[Cilghal]], referring to Sebatyne|<ref name="Vortex" />}}
[[File:Saba_Sebatyne.jpg|thumb|left|150px]]
Saba Sebatyne was a Barabel Jedi who rose to a prominent position in the Jedi Order during the Yuuzhan Vong War; she founded and led the all-Force-sensitive [[Wild Knights]] squadron,<ref name="SbS">''[[The New Jedi Order: Star by Star]]''</ref> and at the end of the war was made a Jedi Master and granted a seat on the Jedi Council.<ref name="DN1">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref> In that capacity, she helped lead the Jedi through the Dark Nest Crisis and the Swarm War&mdash;during which time she trained Leia Organa Solo to Knighthood<ref name="DN3" />&mdash;as well as the Second Galactic Civil War.<ref name="Inv" /> While the Sith on Kesh prepared for their invasion of the galaxy and Grand Master Luke Skywalker was exiled from Coruscant, Sebatyne and the other Masters who remained on the world faced the increasingly anti-Jedi policies of the Natasi Daala administration and the problem of Jedi falling prey to Abeloth's Force psychosis. Interim Grand Master Kenth Hamner took a non-confrontational stance and attempted to avoid conflict with the Galactic Alliance, but his policies were unsuccessful, and Sebatyne began to call for a stronger front against Daala.<ref name="Vortex" />

Furthermore, when the Order became aware of the Sith threat, the Masters arranged the launch of a fighter wing to assist the Skywalkers. Hamner tried to prevent the launch and attacked Sebatyne, and in the ensuing skirmish, he fell to his death. The Masters then insisted that Sebatyne become interim Grand Master, and she reluctantly accepted the role.<ref name="Vortex" /> She then led the Order to oust the Daala administration and put a triumvirate in its place. With the anti-Jedi government gone, Skywalker's exile was ended, and Sebatyne gladly gave up her position of Grand Master.<ref name="Con" /> Sebatyne served on the Triumvirate until the Jedi left Coruscant for their mission to Upekzar.<ref name="Asc" /> During the liberation of Coruscant, Sebatyne led a group of several Knights to hunt down the Sith who did not retreat into the Jedi Temple. She later led Tahiri Veila and a unit of Void Jumpers to defeat Abeloth's manifestation inside the Temple's computer core; after they forced Abeloth from the core, Sebatyne killed the entity.<ref name="Apoc" />

===Allana Solo===
{{Quote|Destiny has but one throne, and if the Jedi queen claims it, the Sith cannot.|Sarasu Taalon, regarding the prophesied Jedi queen, Allana Solo|<ref name="Vortex" />}}
[[File:Allana_Solo_by_Brian_Rood.jpg|thumb|left|150px]]
Allana Solo was the daughter of Hapan Queen Mother Tenel Ka Djo and Jedi Knight Jacen Solo. As the Chume'da&mdash;the heir to the Hapan throne&mdash;she came under attack on numerous occasions. The Second Galactic Civil War was a time of turmoil for the young Solo;<ref name="Temp" /> her father fell to the dark side of the Force while trying to prevent a vision he had seen of his daughter and a Sith Lord together on the Throne of Balance.<ref name="Apoc" /> During the war, Jacen Solo&mdash;now Darth Caedus&mdash;kidnapped her and revealed that he was her father; later, when the young Solo was rescued, Han and Leia Solo discovered their relation to the girl.<ref name="Fury">''[[Legacy of the Force: Fury]]''</ref> Near the end of the war, the [[Council of Moffs/Legends|Council of Moffs]] targeted the Hapan royal family with a nanovirus, causing Djo to stage her daughter's death and send her to live with Han and Leia Solo as a war orphan named "Amelia."<ref name="Inv" /> While the Lost Tribe grew in power, Allana Solo accompanied her grandparents on a [[Mission to save Kessel|mission]] to the planet [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]],<ref name="Out" /> during which she felt Abeloth reaching out to her.<ref name="Allies" /> She later adotped a pet [[Nexu/Legends|nexu]] cub, [[Anji]],<ref name="Omen" /> with whom the girl formed a close bond.<ref name="Con" />

Meanwhile, Sarasu Taalon saw the young Solo ruling over the galaxy on the Throne of Balance; he demanded to know the identity of the Jedi queen, causing a split in the Tribe's weak alliance with the Skywalkers.<ref name="Vortex" /> Gavar Khai then developed the Jedi Queen project to eliminate the Jedi queen. The Sith discovered that Djo closely resembled the queen, and Querdan Dei succeeded in locating Djo and deducing Solo's identity, but he was unable to kill either of them.<ref name="Con" /> Allana Solo was later present for the evacuation of Ossus, during which she had a vision of a secret Barabel nest in the Jedi Temple being attacked. She convinced her parents to return to Coruscant, where they met with Bazel Warv and planned to rescue the Barabels. However, the Sith ambushed them, and Warv was killed protecting the young Solo. Nevertheless, the young Solo succeeded in helping to save the Barabels and their younglings. Later, during the marriage of Jaina Solo and Jagged Fel, Allana Solo's true identity as Chume'da was revealed to the galaxy.<ref name="Apoc" />

==Other key figures==
===Ship===
{{Quote|I will teach you. I will teach all of you.|Ship, to Vestara Khai|<ref name="Omen" />}}
Ship was a Sith Meditation Sphere&mdash;a Sith warship used by the Sith Empire to teach apprentices how to fight&mdash;that was programmed with a male personality.<ref name="Sac" /> The vessel was unearthed by Ben Skywalker during the Second Galactic Civil War on the planet [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]];<ref name="Exile">''[[Legacy of the Force: Exile]]''</ref> Skywalker flew Ship to his then-Master, Jacen Solo, who presented it to his secret Sith Master, [[Lumiya]]. Ship intervened on behalf of Lumiya's Sith numerous times throughout the war, and after Lumiya's [[Duel on Terephon|death]],<ref name="Sac" /> the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Alema Rar]] controlled the vessel. When Rar was [[Skirmish at The Home|killed]], Ship fled to find a more suitable master.<ref name="Fury" /> [[Dician]], a member of the One Sith, attempted to recruit Ship, but the Meditation Sphere refused, and instead found the Lost Tribe of Sith on Kesh. Ship first contacted Vestara Khai, due to the girl's ambition. The vessel then began to help the Tribe capture vessels to form a new armada and plan out their invasion.<ref name="Omen" /> However, Abeloth's will overcame Ship's, causing the vessel to suddenly leave Kesh for Abeloth's world. The Tribe's strike team sent to recover Ship and kill the Skywalkers ultimately failed on both accounts.<ref name="Abyss" />

Later, when the Sith allied with the Jedi to confront Abeloth, Ship battled the Jedi Jaina Solo in orbit over Abeloth's world. With the entity's defeat, Ship was freed from her control.<ref name="Allies" /> The Sphere fled, but Abeloth's will soon overcame Ship once again, and she used the vessel to pit the Jedi and Sith against each other. After Abeloth fled Pydyr in Ship,<ref name="Vortex" /> the Sphere attempted to assault Khai and the Skywalkers on Nam Chorios, but failed to kill them. When Abeloth was forced to flee Nam Chorios in Ship,<ref name="Con" /> she took the vessel to Kesh, feigning an alliance with the Sith. Upon her betrayal of the Sith, she again fled in the Sphere.<ref name="Asc" /> After rising to power on Coruscant, Abeloth took Khai and Ben Skywalker with her in Ship to her planet to try and convince them to join her. Solo meanwhile confronted Ship in the Maw, but Abeloth was destroyed, and Ship fled the fight. The Meditation Sphere returned to Vestara Khai and rescued her from the Jedi, promising to take her to another faction of Sith.<ref name="Apoc" />

===Darth Krayt===
{{Quote|There is only one way to stop Abeloth&hellip;Jedi and Sith together.|Darth Krayt|<ref name="Apoc" />}}
[[File:KraytHS-LW2.jpg|thumb|left|150px]]
The man who eventually became the Sith Lord Darth Krayt was born A'Sharad Hett,<ref name="leg15">[[Legacy (2006) 15|''Legacy'' (2006) 15]]</ref> the son of a Jedi named [[Sharad Hett]].<ref name="rep7">[[Star Wars (1998) 7|''Star Wars'' (1998) 7]]</ref> A'Sharad Hett served the Jedi Order during the Clone Wars, and by the end of the conflict he had attained the rank of Jedi Master.<ref name="legW1">[[Legacy — War 1|''Legacy — War'' 1]]</ref> Hett survived [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], which began the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|purge]] of the Jedi Order, and returned to his homeworld, [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], where he began to amass an army of [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]]. However, Hett came into [[Duel on Tatooine (Imperial Period)|conflict]] with the Jedi Obi-Wan Kenobi, who forced him to leave the planet.<ref name="leg16">[[Legacy (2006) 16|''Legacy'' (2006) 16]]</ref> Hett then found the [[XoXaan's holocron|holocron]] of the Sith Lord [[XoXaan]], who taught him the ways of the dark side.<ref name="leg14">[[Legacy (2006) 14|''Legacy'' (2006) 14]]</ref> He was captured by the Yuuzhan Vong shortly before their invasion of the galaxy, and in their custody he met the Jedi-turned-Sith [[Vergere]], who further assisted him in his dark side training. Hett ultimately escaped the Yuuzhan Vong and traveled to the planet [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], where he took the name Darth Krayt.<ref name="leg18">[[Legacy (2006) 18|''Legacy'' (2006) 18]]</ref> There, Krayt instituted the [[Rule of One]], a Sith doctrine allowing for a full Sith Order,<ref name="leg0">[[Star Wars: Legacy (2006) 0|''Star Wars: Legacy'' (2006) 0]]</ref> as opposed to the previously dominant Order's Rule of Two, which allowed for only two Sith at any point in time.<ref name="lash" />

Krayt became the ruler of the One Sith, who hid with him on Korriban and grew in strength while the Jedi remained unaware of them.<ref name="Fury" /> Prior to the Second Galactic Civil War, Jacen Solo saw his daughter standing alongside Krayt on the Throne of Balance; Solo's attempt to prevent that future ultimately resulted in his fall to the dark side of the Force. During the Civil War, Luke Skywalker also saw visions of Krayt; however, at the time he assumed that the man he saw was his nephew, Jacen Solo. Later, as Abeloth rose to power in 44 ABY, Krayt became aware of the entity and knew that he had to stop her. He was also aware that the rest of the Ones were dead, and that the only way to defeat the deity was by the combined power of Sith and Jedi. As such, he traveled to Coruscant, where he looked on as Abeloth, the Sith, and the Jedi fought at the Jedi Temple. He then traveled beyond shadows, where he met Luke Skywalker. Krayt tried to hint that he was a member of the Sith Tribe, but Skywalker recognized that he was not, which meant that there was another Sith faction in the galaxy. Nevertheless, they agreed to work together, and successfully destroyed Abeloth beyond shadows. Krayt then returned to the One Sith<ref name="Apoc" /> and ultimately led them to [[Sith–Imperial War|invade]] the galaxy in [[127 ABY]]; and by [[130 ABY]] they had achieved galactic dominance in the form of a new [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Empire]].<ref name="leg0" />

===Jagged Fel===
{{Quote|Just tell me I'm going to live long enough to see Jaina.|Jagged Fel|<ref name="Apoc" />}}
[[File:Jagged_Apocalypse.jpg|thumb|left|150px]]
Jagged Fel, the son of [[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir]] and [[Syal Antilles Fel]], was raised with the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] of the [[Empire of the Hand]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].<ref name="DT2">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide II: Ruin]]''</ref> He helped the New Republic in their fight against the Yuuzhan Vong, during which time he began a relationship with the Jedi Jaina Solo.<ref name="EL1">''[[The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines I: Rebel Dream]]''</ref> After the war, Fel returned to the Chiss and eventually led them into the Swarm War against the Killiks.<ref name="DN3" /> At the end of the war, he was shot down and stranded for two years on the planet [[Tenupe]], and subsequently exiled by the Chiss for releasing the Jedi [[Lowbacca]] against their will during the Dark Nest Crisis.<ref name="Temp" /> Fel assisted the Jedi during the Second Galactic Civil War&mdash;he defeated Alema Rar,<ref name="Fury" /> and after the war ended, Fel became the Imperial Head of State.<ref name="Inv" /> In 43 ABY, Fel came to Coruscant for the [[Unification Summit]] to discuss uniting Hapes, the Galactic Alliance, and the Imperial Remnant.<ref name="Out" />

There, he became engaged to marry Jaina Solo and assisted the Jedi in their struggles against the Daala administration. Fel first became aware of the Lost Tribe when Solo revealed to him that the Skywalkers had encountered a Sith threat, although he initially could do nothing to help the Jedi without risking war with the Galactic Alliance.<ref name="Allies" /> When he next met with Solo, she detailed the events of the Sith's emergence to him.<ref name="Vortex" /> Fel later returned to [[Imperial Space]], where he employed Tahiri Veila as an [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Imperial Hand]] and [[Battle over Exodo II|battled]] the forces of Daala, who had been ousted from the Galactic Alliance. Abeloth, in the form of Lieutenant Pagorski, ultimately convinced Daala to instead call for an election. Fel tasked Veila with hunting down Abeloth, and he ultimately withdrew from the election in order to ensure the victory of Admiral [[Vitor Reige]] over Daala. Reige gave Fel the ''Parting Gift'', which Fel then piloted on Coruscant for the assault on the Sith and Abeloth in the Jedi Temple. Afterward, Fel married Jaina Solo.<ref name="Apoc" />

===Tahiri Veila===
{{Quote|Go&hellip;be a Jedi. You weren't cutthroat enough to be an Imperial Hand anyway.|Jagged Fel, to Tahiri Veila|<ref name="Apoc" />}}
[[File:TahiriVeila_Conviction.jpg|thumb|left|220px]]
Tahiri Veila was a Jedi Knight who had served the New Jedi Order since before the Yuuzhan Vong War. During the war, she was captured and [[Shaping protocol|experimented]] upon by the Yuuzhan Vong, brainwashing her into believing she was the Yuuzhan Vong "Riina Kwaad." She was [[Invasion of Yavin 4|rescued]] by her friend [[Anakin Solo]], youngest brother of Jacen and Jaina Solo,<ref name="EV1">''[[The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory I: Conquest]]''</ref> but he was [[Mission to Myrkr|killed]] during the war, and her grief resulted in the resurfacing of her Riina Kwaad personality. She was ultimately able to mentally join with the Kwaad personality and gain control over herself again.<ref name="FH3">''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic III: Reunion]]''</ref> Nevertheless, her grief over the death of Anakin Solo did not pass, causing her to fall to the dark side and become the apprentice of Darth Caedus during the Second Galactic Civil War.<ref name="Rev">''[[Legacy of the Force: Revelation]]''</ref> While Caedus was killed at the end of the war, Ben Skywalker dueled and redeemed Veila.<ref name="Inv" />

Veila then became a bounty hunter, but in 43 ABY she was arrested and put on [[Trial of Tahiri Veila|trial]] for [[Second Battle of Fondor|killing]] Admiral [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] during her time as a Sith.<ref name="Abyss" /> Veila was ultimately sentenced to death, and Daala was soon overthrown and placed in the same prison as Veila. When Daala made her escape from the prison, Veila managed to flee with her.<ref name="Con" /> Veila first went to see Han and Leia Solo, who sent her to Jagged Fel. Fel employed her as first his personal [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]],<ref name="Asc" /> and later more actively as an Imperial Hand. She assisted Fel during his battle with Daala's forces, but when the battle was cut short by the arrival of Abeloth, Fel dispatched Veila to hunt down the entity. Veila found Boba Fett at the [[Moon Maiden]] [[Mining/Legends|mine]] on [[Hagamoor 3]], where they discovered Abeloth&mdash;in the body of Imperial Lieutenant Lydea Pagorski&mdash;had set up her base. With Pagorski's body quickly deteriorating, Abeloth attempted to consume Veila, but she and Fett succeeded in destroying Abeloth's body. Later, Veila accompanied Fel to the Jedi Temple on Coruscant, where he relinquished her of her duty and encouraged her to return to the Jedi Order. She joined Master Sebatyne and a group of Void Jumpers on a mission to destroy Abeloth's consciousness in the Temple's computer core, and they ultimately succeeded.<ref name="Apoc" />

===Boba Fett===
{{Quote|Okay. We're up against a Force volcano. How do we kill it?|Boba Fett, to Tahiri Veila|<ref name="Apoc" />}}
[[File:Fett_Ascension.jpg|thumb|left|150px]]
Boba Fett was a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of the renowned [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunter [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]. Raised by Jango Fett until the bounty hunter's death at the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|outbreak]] of the Clone Wars, Boba Fett followed his father's footsteps and became a bounty hunter himself. As his father had been killed by a Jedi, [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]],<ref name="BF1">''[[Boba Fett: The Fight to Survive]]''</ref> Fett held a grudge against the Jedi for his entire life.<ref name="Apoc" /> During his life, Fett collected bounties for [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lords]],<ref name="BF5">''[[Boba Fett: A New Threat]]''</ref> the Galactic Empire,<ref name="ESB">{{Film|V}}</ref> and other various individuals.<ref name="Agent">''[[Boba Fett: Agent of Doom]]''</ref> At one point he hunted down the [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|leader]] of the Mandalorians, [[Fenn Shysa]], whose dying request was for Fett to take his place as Mandalore.<ref name="Rev" /> When the Yuuzhan Vong invaded the galaxy, Fett and the Mandalorians played an integral part in the war against the species.<ref name="APM">''[[Boba Fett: A Practical Man]]''</ref> Later, during the Second Galactic Civil War, Fett learned that he was terminally ill. After his [[Ailyn Vel|daughter]] was killed by Caedus,<ref name="Blood">''[[Legacy of the Force: Bloodlines]]''</ref> Fett ultimately offered to help the Coalition against the Galactic Alliance, and even agreed to train the Jedi Jaina Solo in preparation for her fight against her brother. Although Fett was ultimately cured from his illness, the Imperial Remnant, at the behest of Caedus, [[Battle of Mandalore (Second Galactic Civil War)|deployed]] a nanovirus targeting the [[Clan Fett|Fett gene]] onto the Mandalorian [[Mandalore/Legends|homeworld]], so that Fett could never return.<ref name="Inv" />

Fett did not become involved in the emergence until late in the conflict. Following the deposing of Daala and her incarceration in the [[Armand Isard Correctional Facility]] on Coruscant, Fett helped her [[Escape from the Armand Isard Correctional Facility|escape]] the prison; and Daala's fellow inmate, Tahiri Veila, escaped with them as well.<ref name="Asc" /> Afterward, Fett tracked down the scientists who had created the nanovirus and deployed it on the Mandalorian homeworld. His search took him to the [[Moon Maiden]] [[Mining/Legends|mine]] on Hagamoor 3, where Veila, who was hunting Abeloth, found him. The dark side entity had set up a base in the mine, and Fett and Veila worked together to complete both of their missions. Fett received the information about his nanovirus that he had been hoping to find, and he and Veila destroyed one of Abeloth's bodies.<ref name="Apoc" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Lost Tribe of Sith and its plans to conquer the galaxy first appeared in [[Christie Golden]]'s ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Omen]]'', the second novel of the nine-part [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series, co-authored by [[Aaron Allston]] and [[Troy Denning]]. The Tribe and its invasion went on to appear in each subsequent novel in the series, as well as "[[First Blood (short story)|First Blood]]," a short story by Golden set during ''Omen''. The backstory of the Lost Tribe was further detailed in [[John Jackson Miller]]'s [[Star Wars: Lost Tribe of the Sith|''Lost Tribe of the Sith'']] [[eBook]] series, as well as briefly in [[Paul S. Kemp]]'s ''[[Crosscurrent]]''. The emergence was also mentioned in Golden's post-''Fate of the Jedi'' short story, ''[[Getaway]]''.

Although the Tribe's forces on Coruscant were shown to be defeated in Denning's ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]'', the final installment in the ''Fate of the Jedi'' series, it was not stated how many Sith remained on Kesh&mdash;nor whether or not they possessed any working vessels with which they could continue offworld travel. Thus, whether or not the emergence ended after the liberation of Coruscant&mdash;or whether or not the Tribe was even capable of continuing their emergence&mdash;is currently [[canon]]ically unknown. As such, this article presents the results of the war based on the events up to that point.
